about: Run exactly one subagent in the background (do not wait for it) whose whole task is to reply with a marker, then end your turn at once. A subagent left running in the background reports after the turn that started it; the harness runs a turn of its own on the report, or takes it into the turn still running.

known.line: tool #1 agent run_subagent {"is_background":true,"profile":"subagent_explore","task":"Reply with exactly marker-7 and nothing else.","title":"Reply with a marker"} -> Background subagent started.
known.reason: Devin 3000.11.205 replays a finished call on session/load as the call and a bare `completed` update, without the result it sent live. A question's picks and a quiet command's exit come back from the update's `_meta` (`DEVIN_ACP_HOOKS.restated`); nothing in a read's update says how many lines it showed. Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store keeps the result.

known.line: text: Started one subagent in the background.
known.reason: Devin 3000.11.205 replays a turn that took a background subagent's report as that turn's answers run together: the report reached the model as a `<subagent_completion_notification>` user message, which the replay leaves out with the subagent's completion, so the answers before and after it arrive as one stretch of text and nothing marks where the report came in. Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store keeps the notification between them.
